newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: France extends 188.4 mln ffr loan to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: France extends 188.4 mln ffr loan to Philippines.

text.p: France and the Philippines signed on Thursday the Ninth Financial Protocol which extended loans worth 188.4 million francs to the Philippines, the Department of Finance said.
A 2.85 million franc grant was also included in the protocol. The grant will finance the cattle breeding project of the agriculture department, the finance department said in a statement.
The loan component has a mix of 60 percent government treasury loan and 40 percent commercial credit.

The Treasury loan carries an interest of 1.5 percent and is payable in 25 years, while the commercial loan has an interest rate equivalent to the Commercial International Reference Rate and is payable in 10 years.

The loans will finance the upgrading of the radiological capabilities of selected government hospitals, the rehabilitation of a rural water system, and the maritime distress and safety system project.
The financial protocol is an annual assistance package being provided by the French government since 1988.
